prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Continue to Controls", "Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet directly from your desktop system tray.", "Finish Setup", "Right-click system tray icon to hide or summon pet"]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Rendering Engine", "Initial setup may take a few moments while graphic assets render."]
2: ["Signing in automatically saves and restores all your active pets across logins."]
3: ["Use clear, well-lit photos with full views for best custom pet rendering results."]
4: ["Start Control Tutorial", "Test Your Desktop Pet Commands", "Practice hiding and summoning your companion before completing onboarding.", "Complete Onboarding"]
5: []
6: ["Review Pet Summary", "Pet Companion Passport", "Your companion is ready to be loaded onto your desktop environment.", "Proceed to Launch"]
7: ["Loading Desktop Pet Assets", "Checking graphics renderer, desktop overlay system, and sound engine readiness."]
8: ["We will notify you as soon as your custom pet design is processed."]
9: ["Look for the pet icon in your system tray anytime to open settings or toggle pet visibility."]
